meta.name: release-note-bundle
meta.description: Validate a release note source file, package it through a container step, and emit a final bundled note with recorded container identity.

argv:
python3 - <<'PY'
import pathlib

source_note = pathlib.Path("{params.source_note}")
if not source_note.is_file():
    raise SystemExit("source_note is not a file: " + str(source_note))

text = source_note.read_text(encoding="utf-8").strip()
if not text:
    raise SystemExit("source_note is empty: " + str(source_note))

out_dir = pathlib.Path("../outputs/prepared")
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
(out_dir / "source.txt").write_text(text + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
metadata = [
    "bundle_label={params.bundle_label}",
    "source_path=" + str(source_note.resolve()),
    "source_bytes=" + str(len(text.encode("utf-8")))
]
(out_dir / "metadata.txt").write_text("\n".join(metadata) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
PY

set -eu
SOURCE=/bijux/node/inputs/prepare_note/source
METADATA=/bijux/node/inputs/prepare_note/metadata
LABEL=$(sed -n 's/^bundle_label=//p' "$METADATA")
SOURCE_BYTES=$(sed -n 's/^source_bytes=//p' "$METADATA")
mkdir -p /bijux/node/outputs/bundle
{
  printf '%s\n' "$LABEL"
  cat "$SOURCE"
} > /bijux/node/outputs/bundle/release-note.txt
cat > /bijux/node/outputs/bundle/container-summary.json <<EOF
{
  "bundle_label": "$LABEL",
  "source_bytes": $SOURCE_BYTES,
  "container_workdir": "$(pwd)"
}
EOF
printf 'container-package-stdout'
printf 'container-package-stderr' >&2
